item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Programmed Training in Microsoft Foundry
item.description:
Programmed Training is now in public preview in Microsoft Foundry. It provides an API for building custom post-training loops over open-weight models, with access available by request through a preview sign-up form.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: visualstudio: Live technical training, wherever you are: A VSLive! benefit for Visual Studio subscribers
item.description:
Microsoft announced a VSLive! benefit for Visual Studio subscribers: live technical training accessible wherever they are. The post frames this as a way to build AI tool skills through structured learning beyond docs and tutorials.

  • Source: Visual Studio Blog
